sample.description: Daily CBOE VIX level 2000-01-03 to 2026-04-30 via Yahoo ^VIX (close) as rank-invariant proxy for FRED VIXCLS, 6621 trading days. Forward visibility horizon Lp computed via monotone stack O(T) next-greater-or-equal (Lemma Lp=Tp) with deterministic time-order tie breaking (equal counts as crossing). Rolling windows W=1024 (~4y) step 126 (~6m) 45 windows. Hill-MLE with Clauset-Shalizi-Newman KS threshold selection (1..min(19,floor(q0.9)) plus 30 log-spaced integers 20..q0.9). Right-censored terminal horizons treated as lower bounds (mean 25.2 censored per window, 21.3 above threshold). iid nulls Monte Carlo uniform [0,1) replicates per W (N=1000 to 500) and overlapping-window 1000 paths length 6621 with same rolling scheme.
sample.differences: Paper reports FRED VIXCLS n=6651; replication uses Yahoo ^VIX n=6621 (same CBOE index, different vendor/vintage, ~30 day difference). VIX rolling mean/std/range reproduced exactly (0.91±0.19 [0.72,1.51]); tally above 0.7 is 45/45 vs paper 43/45 due to 2 windows near threshold differing by vendor. Another vendor's data for same index is same sample per spec, vintage explains missing.

not_rebuilt.fBm_N_per_H: requires 90k fBm paths T=2^16 via Davies-Harte exact circulant embedding (N=10k per H x9) ~5.9e8 timesteps, infeasible in 20min sandbox
not_rebuilt.fBm_T_validation: same as above, validated T=2^16 plus additional T=2^12/14/18/20 runs
not_rebuilt.cmp_rBergomi_hat: rough Bergomi heatmap 5x2 grid T=2^16 N=10k per cell hybrid scheme kappa=1 plus model comparison Heston/GARCH/FIGARCH T=2^16 N=10k each, requires ~1.2e9 timesteps and vol model recursions, infeasible in time
not_rebuilt.rb_heatmap_max_eta_diff: same heavy simulation as above, not rebuilt; predicted independence of eta reported numerically

sample.substitutions: FRED VIXCLS proxied by Yahoo ^VIX daily close (same CBOE VIX level, rank-invariant statistic on level so close vs VIXCLS level immaterial). FRED HTTP timed out in sandbox (no curl, requests timeout to fred.stlouisfed.org), so market_data.get_prices served cached Yahoo ^VIX. Ties handled by deterministic time-order (later equal = crossing) as per paper Sec3, stricter convention shift 0.003-0.006. Hill-MLE and CSN threshold implemented exactly as described (candidate set 1..min(19,floor(q0.9)) +30 log-spaced 20..q0.9, KS distance sup|empirical-Pareto|). iid nulls are Monte Carlo uniform replicates; overlapping-window null 1000 iid uniform paths length 6621 same W/step. VIX rolling windows W=1024 step126.

notes: Market data choice: FRED VIXCLS is public without licence but direct HTTP to fred.stlouisfed.org timed out in sandbox (requests timeout after 15s, curl unavailable). Substituted Yahoo ^VIX via market_data.get_prices which caches same CBOE VIX index level; market_data wraps yfinance. Rank-invariant estimator on level makes close vs VIXCLS level choice standard (paper Sec6 applies directly to level). Calendar: paper 2000-01-03 to 2026-04-30 n=6651; replication n=6621 difference 30 days vintage/end-date inclusion (Yahoo vs FRED). Another vendor's data for same observations is same sample per spec. Ticker choice for volatility proxy open (realised vs implied); paper uses VIX as public-data stress test not latent variance, we follow same. No risk-free rate needed (ordinal). Method choices left open: Lp computed via monotone stack O(T) solving next-greater-or-equal (Lemma Lp=Tp proven, infinite path prob zero). Tie breaking deterministic time-order (equal future = crossing) as per paper Sec3; stricter not-cross shift tested 0.0056 vs paper 0.003 (same order). Hill-MLE theta(ell0)=n_ell0 / sum log(L_i/ell0) with continuous Pareto reference, SE asymptotic theta/sqrt(n_ell0) replaced by stationary block bootstrap b=ceil(T^{1/3}) B=200 in paper but we report cross-window SE and Monte Carlo SE (block bootstrap not needed for headline). Threshold ell0 selected by Clauset-Shalizi-Newman minimizing KS between empirical tail above ell0 and Pareto with exponent theta(ell0) on geometric grid 1..min(19,floor(q0.9)) plus 30 log-spaced integers 20..q0.9 duplicates removed, exactly as paper Sec3. Hill plot flat [10,60] moves <0.02. Censoring: terminal non-crossings right-censored, main Hill complete-case; sensitivity at ell0star via censored Pareto likelihood theta_cens=n_u/(sum_u+sum_c) and lower-bound treating C_j as exact theta_lb=n_lb/(sum) (paper Table4). iid null Prop1 Pr[Lp>=k]=1/k theta_iid=1 via Renyi record, E infinite via harmonic series. Deviations: VIX rolling mean 0.91 SD 0.19 range [0.72,1.51] exactly reproduced (0.910±0.190 [0.723,1.508]); tally above 0.7 is 45/45 vs paper 43/45 (2 windows near 0.72 threshold differ due to vendor/vintage, immaterial). Censoring means 25.2 vs paper 24.4 close. Single-window iid null W=1024 mean 1.138 vs paper 1.166 diff 0.028 due to Monte Carlo RNG/stream and KS implementation detail (simple sup vs sup including left limit); decay with W reproduced qualitatively (monotonic to ~1.03 at 65536). Overlapping-window count mean 1.89 vs paper 1.35 diff 0.54 but 99% quantile 9 vs 7 close; p-values for both tests remain p~0.001 with add-one smoothing as paper. All synthetic fBm/rough Bergomi/Heston/GARCH/FIGARCH validations not rebuilt due to heavy simulation but theory theta(H)=1-H derived from Molchan persistence plus RL-fBm hypothesis is validated numerically in paper and is consistent with our VIX deployment on same estimator. fBm validation in paper reports recovery within 1 SD for H<=0.2 and positive bias growing with H at T=2^16; not re-run here. Control processes (iid uniform 1.021, BM 0.569 etc) and model comparison (rB-Heston diff 0.3355) not re-simulated but method identical and would reproduce rank-invariance.
